# Bundled broker SDK

Source: https://github.com/Kotak-Neo/kotak-neo-python

SDK version: 3.0.7

Upstream commit: `27b9f002306961040aceaa5bd8b8539a3dbbc76d`

The `neo_api_client` package is included unchanged so the dashboard does not depend on a sibling checkout. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Runtime dependencies are pinned in the dashboard's root `requirements.lock`.
